name: Cornmeal
siboNotes: Naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Choose plain cornmeal without added seasonings or wheat-based ingredients.
preparationTips: Check labels for added wheat flour or high-FODMAP seasonings
Cook with lactose-free milk or water instead of regular milk
Add low-FODMAP herbs like oregano or basil for flavor
Can be used as breading for proteins or made into polenta
